title: StrongLifts 5×5 – Workout A
creator: Mehdi Hadim (Stronglifts)
description: Three full-body barbell workouts a week, alternating A and B, five sets of five on every lift except a single set of five deadlifts. Start light (empty bar), add 2.5 kg every workout (5 kg on deadlift), deload 10% after three failed workouts on a lift. The most popular beginner barbell programme on the internet; it works because the load rises every session.

source.title: Stronglifts 5×5 Workout Program: Quick Start Guide

items.name: Squat 5×5
items.note: Rest 90 s if the last set was easy, 3 min if hard, 5 min after a failed set

steps.note: Add 2.5 kg next workout if you got 5/5/5/5/5

items.name: Bench press 5×5
items.note: Rest 90 s if the last set was easy, 3 min if hard, 5 min after a failed set

steps.note: Add 2.5 kg next workout if you got 5/5/5/5/5

items.name: Barbell row 5×5
items.note: Rest 90 s if the last set was easy, 3 min if hard, 5 min after a failed set

steps.note: Add 2.5 kg next workout if you got 5/5/5/5/5 (start at 30 kg, bar from the floor each rep)
